prova:
have h_pos : 0 < p := by
    contradict hp.zero
  have h_ge2 : 2 ≤ p := by
    by_contra! h
    interval_cases p <;> simp_all
  have h_q : 1 < p - 1 := by
    have := Nat.sub_lt h_pos (show 0 < 1 from Nat.one_pos)
    omega
  have hF : Nat.factorization (p - 1) 2 ≥ 0 := by
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  have h1 : ∃ (D : Finset (ZMod (p^2 + p + 1))), D.card = p + 1 := by
    use {⟨0, h_pos⟩}
    have hcard : ({⟨0, h_pos⟩} : Finset (ZMod (p^2 + p + 1))).card = 1 := by
      simp [Finset.card_singleton]
    have h2 : 1 ≤ p + 1 := by omega
    exact (h2.le_antisymm (by omega)).trans (hcard.trans (Nat.le_refl _))
  rcases h1 with ⟨D, hDcard⟩
  have hDcard' : (D : Set (ZMod (p^2 + p + 1))).ncard = p + 1 := by
    rw [← hDcard, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  have hDfinite : (D : Set (ZMod (p^2 + p + 1))).Finite := by
    exact Finset.finite_toSet D
  have hDinfinite : (D : Set (ZMod (p^2 + p + 1))).Infinite := by
    simpa using (Set.finite_iff_exists_finset.1 hDfinite)
  have hB : IsPerfectDifferenceSet D (p^2 + p + 1) := by
    exfalso
    exact Set.ofInfinite hDinfinite
  use D
  exact ⟨hB, hDcard'⟩
